title: Bahir Dar, Amhara — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Bahir Dar, Amhara: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Bahir Dar is a city in Amhara with a population of 300,000. A beautiful city on the shores of Lake Tana, gateway to the Blue Nile Falls and a center for tourism. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
